newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express won't confirm plant report.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express won't confirm plant report.

text.p: Federal Express Corp Monday declined to confirm a published report it plans to build a 350,000-square-foot package-sorting facility in suburban Chicago.

Crain's Chicago Business reported Monday the package delivery giant has selected a 50-acre parcel in Woodridge, Illinois, for the $70-million project. The facility would create about 700 jobs, the report said.

"Nothing has been confirmed (regarding Woodridge) at this point," a Federal Express spokeswoman told Reuters. She added that the Memphis-based company is always looking at new sites for processing plant consolidations or related projects.
Meanwhile, a spokeswoman for the Woodridge economic development office said Federal Express has expressed an interest in the site, but has not signed any formal agreements.
A spokesman for a Chicago-based real estate company reportedly involved in the deal could not be reached for comment.
